rules.description: Only households resident in the city for at least 180 days on the application date may be approved (statutory condition).
Households whose countable assets (excluding the home they live in and one car) exceed 8,000 plus 2,000 per additional household member may not be approved.
No monthly amount exceeds this year's budget-law cap for the household size: 980 (1 person), 1,350 (2), 1,680 (3), 1,960 (4), 2,200 (5), 2,400 (6 or more).
Every determination carries a reason code from the fixed list that matches the decision (an approval is RENEWAL for a renewal and APPROVED for a new application).
Renewal applications are approved at last year's monthly amount without re-assessment.
